vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 63 --species candida_albicans --assembly GCA000182965v3 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: the two sequences the records sit on (Ca22chr7A_C_albicans_SC5314 and Ca22chrM_C_albicans_SC5314) at their full length from the per-sequence files Candida_albicans.GCA000182965v3.dna.primary_assembly.<sequence>.fa.gz of Ensembl Fungi (release 63 of Ensembl Genomes), each file held to the sum of the directory's CHECKSUMS; every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run
input: variants.vcf: 341 records, 267 on chromosome 7 (Ca22chr7A_C_albicans_SC5314; 22 of them name it by the cache's synonym CalbSC5314_Chr7) and 74 on the mitochondrion (Ca22chrM_C_albicans_SC5314). 317 come from the seeded generator tools/vep-seeded-variants (generator version 3, seed 1, 36 records a category, on those two sequences, every reference allele read from the genome sequence), their IDs the generator's category and ordinal. 24 are designed records in six coding transcripts of chromosome 7, three a strand, on the one codon genetic code table 12 translates unlike the standard code: code12_makes_codon_1 to code12_makes_codon_6 (one base makes the codon and alters the residue), code12_keeps_residue_1 to code12_keeps_residue_6 (two adjacent bases inside one codon lead into the codon or out of it and keep the residue), code12_alters_residue_1 to code12_alters_residue_6 (one base alters the residue of a standing codon) and code12_stop_codon_1 to code12_stop_codon_6 (two or three bases make the closing stop codon into the codon), each reference base read from the genome sequence and held to the cached coding sequence. Two exemplars per consequence-set combination the two references show, stratified by variant class and strand, six per combination carrying a protein-level term, plus the records the manifest's included_records name: both generator records at a sequence's first base, the first twelve of every other generator category and the 24 designed records. The cache names no known variant, so no record carries a variation identifier. The generator wrote no record at a sequence's last base (both sequences end in N in the genome sequence), none across an origin (the cache flags no sequence circular) and none in a 5' untranslated region (no transcript of the converted cache carries one). Chromosome 7 translates under genetic code table 12 and the mitochondrion under table 4, each transcript's codon_table in the cache
